description: This file defines functions for creating Elasticsearch index templates with specific analyzers and mappings for Mattermost, including support for different language analyzers (Nori, Kuromoji, SmartCN) and templates for posts, files, channels, and users.

methods.name: addQueryProperty
methods.description: Adds a text property with a specific analyzer to the mappings for Elasticsearch indexing.

methods.name: WithNoriAnalyzer
methods.description: Configures Elasticsearch template with Nori analyzer for Japanese text processing.

methods.name: WithKuromojiAnalyzer
methods.description: Configures Elasticsearch template with Kuromoji analyzer for Japanese text processing.

methods.name: WithSmartCNAnalyzer
methods.description: Configures Elasticsearch template with Smart Chinese analyzer.

methods.name: GetPostTemplate
methods.description: Creates an Elasticsearch index template for posts with specific settings and mappings.

methods.name: GetFileInfoTemplate
methods.description: Creates an Elasticsearch index template for file info with specific settings and mappings.

methods.name: GetChannelTemplate
methods.description: Creates an Elasticsearch index template for channels with specific settings and mappings.

methods.name: GetUserTemplate
methods.description: Creates an Elasticsearch index template for users with specific settings and mappings.
